jobs.occupation: Marketing Director
jobs.description:
Sky‑Watch A/S is a leading Danish drone company that since 2009 has specialized in the development, production, and servicing of high‑technology mini UAS systems for Defense – nationally and internationally. With more than 155+ dedicated employees and a strong international growth journey underway, Sky‑Watch today stands as one of the most innovative players within tactical mini UAV systems. At Sky‑Watch, robust, reliable, and advanced drone systems are developed for demanding environments and critical situations where predictability, mechanical durability, traceability and user safety are paramount.

As an ambitious scale-up company in rapid development, Sky-Watch continues to expand across products, markets and the organization.

To support the company’s international growth and further strengthen the strategic level of its marketing function, we are now looking for an ambitious, strategic and inspiring Director of Marketing.

Strategic Marketing Leadership – International Defense – Commercial Impact

Do you want to shape the marketing direction of a fast-growing high-tech defense company? As Director of Marketing at Sky-Watch, you will lead and develop the marketing function across Product Marketing & Strategy, Field & Event Marketing, and Brand & Digital Influence. You will strengthen the strategic level of marketing, set clear priorities and create the framework for a multidisciplinary team of specialists to succeed. At the same time, you will connect Sky-Watch’s advanced engineering capabilities with customer needs and government procurement requirements, strengthening the company’s positioning and commercial impact in international defense markets.

Working closely with Sales, Business Development and R&D, you will ensure that marketing supports strategic procurement programs, priority accounts and Sky-Watch’s international growth ambitions.

You will report to the VP Marketing and lead a marketing team of five.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Product Marketing & Strategy – positioning, go-to-market strategies, technical narratives, CONOPS and tender enablement.

• Field & Event Marketing – international defense exhibitions, live demonstrations and targeted market activities.

• Visual Brand Design & Digital Influence – compelling visual communication, digital narratives and consistent brand positioning.

• ABM & Partner Enablement – targeted initiatives towards priority accounts, procurement programs and international partners.

• People Leadership – develop the marketing team and create clear direction, collaboration and ownership.

To succeed in this role, you have around 10 years of experience within Marketing and Product Marketing in international high-tech companies, preferably within a regulated industry such as aerospace or defense, combined with a few years of leadership experience. You know how to set strategic direction while empowering specialists to take ownership of execution. You bring experience with Account-Based Marketing, lead generation and partner enablement and understand customer acquisition in public tender-driven markets. Experience with technical product marketing, Tier-1 accounts, international exhibitions and complex hardware and software portfolios will be important in the role, and a strong technical understanding or flair is considered an advantage.

You are based within reasonable commuting distance of Sky-Watch’s location in Støvring or Valby.

As a person, you are a strategic and results-oriented leader with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to translate strategy into execution. You provide clear direction while giving specialists the trust and autonomy to excel within their areas of expertise. You combine strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent communication and interpersonal capabilities. You are curious, adaptable and resilient in a dynamic scale-up environment and bring a collaborative and inclusive approach to leadership. With high accountability, integrity and professionalism, you are motivated by building a strong and high-performing marketing function.

Are you the new Director of Marketing at Sky-Watch? If so, please submit your application and CV as soon as possible. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity or religion. For further information about the position, please contact consultant Martin Tveit, Sensu A/S, by phone at +45 26 83 38 42.

For more information about Sky‑Watch, please visit www.sky-watch.com.

Please note that applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and no application deadline is set.

jobs.occupation: Senior Operational Technology (OT) Security Officer
jobs.description:
Senior Operational Technology (OT) Security Officer

Ørsted

Imagine a future where you'll protect the ability to supply electricity and heat to the end user and make sure that our critical OT systems are protected against hackers

Application deadline 15 November 2026 , 23:59 CET

Country Denmark

Location Esbjerg, Skærbæk, Gentofte, Studstrup Power Station, Avedøre Power Station

Workplace Office-based We offer a workplace culture where you’ll be working from the office every work day.

Working hours 37

Employment type Permanent

Legal entity Ørsted Bioenergy & Thermal Power A/S

Why join?

Proven very high employee satisfaction and motivation

Continuous development opportunities for all employees

Competitive salary, pension scheme, and attractive holiday package

A wide range of health benefits, such as health insurance, nutritious food, and fitness facilities in our office locations

Join us in this role where you’ll be working as a Senior Operational Technology (OT) Security Officer to strengthen the security, resilience, and compliance of Ørsted Bioenergy. In this role, you will act as a trusted security lead across OT, IT, engineering, and operations, helping protect critical systems while enabling safe, reliable, and efficient operations. Further more we are partnering with operations, engineering, maintenance, IT, and third-party vendors to ensure security controls are practical, risk-based, and compatible with operational safety and availability – and we “translate” technical cyber risk into clear business, safety, and operational impact requirements. We operate in complex, multi-site, international, or safety-critical operational environments.

**Welcome to Bioenergy

**You’ll be part of OT Security where you, together with your colleagues, will be working on Ørsted Danish powerplant. Our task is to protect the powerplants ability to produce electricity and heat against hacker attacks. So you need to understand Danish, when you’re out on the powerplants. We are a small team of 4 persons located in Jutland (Jylland) who works together and strive in helping each other in our daily tasks. As a team, we have an open and direct commutation where we discuss ideas strategy and ideas to develop and mature our solutions, so they are robust and they deal with the reality we face.

You’ll play an important role in:

• leading the development and continuous improvement of OT security governance, policies, standards, and procedures

• assessing, managing, and reducing cyber risk across OT environments, including industrial control systems, SCADA, PLCs, IIoT, and related networks

• defining and supporting secure OT architecture, including network segmentation, secure remote access, asset visibility, access control, logging, monitoring, and vulnerability management

• conducting OT security risk assessments, gap analyses, and maturity reviews aligned with recognised frameworks e.g. Danish legislation “Lov om styrket Beredskab i Energisektoren”, IEC 62443, ISO 27001 and relevant regulatory requirements

• partnering with operations, engineering, maintenance, IT, and third-party vendors to ensure security controls are practical, risk-based, and compatible with operational safety and availability requirements

• driving OT security awareness and training for technical and operational teams.

To succeed in the role, you:

• hold a relevant degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, Automation, or equivalent practical experience

• understand and know how to operate in ICS systems and possess understanding of 24/7 production environment

• are familiar with IT networks like, Purdue model, firewall, data diodes etc.

• hold knowledge about EIC 62433, ISO 27001 and "Lov om styrket Beredskab i Energisektoren" as we operate according to this legislation

• are a good team player and at the same are strong on being responsible of incl. conducting your own tasks – you need to be fluent in both Danish and English language as well due to nature our stake holder landscape

• are flexible - both in terms of taking on tasks outside your comfortzone, being curious in learning new areas and assist your team in whatever tasks are needed.

Some travel within Denmark to the different sites must be expected in the this role.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application and CV to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

**Position salary range:

**For this position, the expected base pay range is kr55,040.00- kr82,560.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Our benefits package:

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11 % contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3 % holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and well-being programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, and internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Pre-employment background check:

**This position requires a background check as part of the hiring process and the offer is dependent on the outcome of this check. You will receive more information during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

jobs.occupation: Postdoc of Theoretical Catalysis
jobs.employer_name: KU- SCIENCE - CHEM og MATH og NBI-HCØ
jobs.description:
The Department of Chemistry invites applicants for a 2-year postdoc position within Theoretical Catalysis under the ERC-SyG DEMI, starting from 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible hereafter.

  DEMI (Directed Evolution of Metastable Electrocatalyst Interfaces for Energy Conversion) is an ERC Synergy Grant funded by the European Research Council Executive Agency.

  In the Theoretical Catalysis group, we aim to provide a deeper understanding of catalytic processes and catalytic materials by atomic scale simulations. We have a special interest in electrocatalytic reactions and high entropy materials, and the methods include DFT-simulations, machine learning potentials, Monte Carlo simulations and statistical analysis. We enjoy a close collaboration with experimental groups, both at the department and other universities in Denmark and abroad. The DEMI project is a collaboration with research groups from University of Bern, Ruhr University Bochum and Helmholtz-Institute Erlangen-Nürnberg.

  The Theoretical Catalysis group is part of Center for High Entropy Alloy Catalysis.

  The successful candidate holds a Ph.D. in computational chemistry, DFT-simulations, physical modelling or a similar background. Experience with theoretical catalysis or electrocatalysis is a benefit.

  The postdoc’s duty is primarily research within Theoretical Catalysis but may include performance of other duties.

  Further information on the Department is linked at www.chem.ku.dk. Inquiries about the position can be made to Professor Jan Rossmeisl, phone +4550719584 or email: jan.rossmeisl@chem.ku.dk.

  The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

  Terms of employment

  The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

  Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State.

  Negotiation for salary supplement is possible.

  The application, in English, must be submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

  Please include 

   	
• Motivation for the application 	
• Curriculum vitae 	
• Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent) 	
• Complete publication list   The deadline for applications is 15 November 2026, 23:59 CET. 

  After the deadline for application, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee. 

  You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

jobs.occupation: Solution Lead
jobs.description:
Department: Service Delivery

Location: Vodskov, DK

**Description

**Overview of the Role:

At Veovo, we help airports, transport hubs and major venues understand how people move through their environments, enabling smarter operational decisions and better passenger experiences.

As a Solution Lead, you'll be the crucial link between our customers, project managers and implementation teams. You'll work with customers to understand their operational challenges, translate their requirements into scalable solutions, and ensure successful delivery of Veovo's passenger predictability and flow management technology.

This is a highly visible and varied role that combines customer engagement, data-driven problem solving, technical consultancy and project delivery. You'll help organisations optimise passenger flow, predict congestion, improve queue performance and make better use of real-time operational data.

No two days are the same. One day you may be running a customer workshop, the next reviewing passenger-flow data, advising on sensor placement, or helping an implementation team solve a complex operational challenge.

**Your Key Responsibilities

**

• Act as the primary technical partner to Project Managers, helping define scope, identify risks, and ensure successful delivery of customer projects.

• Lead discovery workshops and work closely with customers to understand operational requirements, passenger flow challenges and business objectives.

• Translate customer needs into clear technical requirements and implementation plans for delivery teams.

• Design and validate passenger flow and data collection solutions that deliver measurable operational value.

• Collaborate with implementation consultants, data specialists and project teams to ensure solutions are deployed successfully and meet customer expectations.

• Serve as the key technical point of contact throughout the project lifecycle for both customers and internal stakeholders.

• Support the design of data-driven solutions using operational, passenger and queueing datasets.

• Advise on hardware deployments, including camera and LiDAR placement, to ensure effective coverage and data collection.

• Promote best practices, documentation standards and knowledge sharing across the wider delivery organisation.

• Conduct solution reviews and contribute to continuous improvement of Veovo's implementation methodology.

**What We’re Looking For:

**

• Experience in solution delivery, implementation consulting, or technical project delivery within software, analytics, or operational technology environments.

• Strong data literacy, with the ability to interpret datasets and explain insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Experience gathering requirements and translating business needs into practical technical solutions.

• Confident communicator with strong stakeholder management and customer-facing skills.

• Familiarity with SQL, databases, or data-driven systems.

• Highly organised, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple priorities.

Nice to Have

• Experience with passenger flow, queue management, or operational analytics.

• Background in aviation, transport, rail, cruise, attractions, or other high-volume operational environments.

• Experience working with time-series/time-scaled datasets.

• Exposure to Tableau, Power BI, or similar analytics platforms.

• Familiarity with cameras, LiDAR, sensor technologies, or computer vision solutions.

• Consulting, professional services, or implementation consulting experience.

**What We Can Offer You

**

• Competitive salary

• Private medical insurance

• Life and income protection

• Enhanced parental leave

• Tailored learning and development opportunities

• Flexible working hours and remote-work opportunities

**Interested?

**If this role sounds like a good fit for you, please click on the “Apply” button to submit your application.

To discover more about Veovo and how we’re using technology to transform operations, please visit our website and LinkedIn.

jobs.occupation: AI Lead
jobs.description:
Shape the technical future of AI at Uni-Tankers

At Uni-Tankers, we see AI as an opportunity to work smarter, make better decisions, and create greater value across the business. We are looking for an AI Solutions Architect/Engineer who can turn business needs and enterprise data into secure, reliable, and practical AI solutions.

As our first AI specialist, you will have a unique opportunity to help shape how AI is designed, developed, and applied across Uni-Tankers. You will be hands-on in building agents, integrations, and AI-enabled solutions. This role is for someone who enjoys building the solutions that empower the organization in a meaningful way.

Reporting to Thomas Thomsen, CFO, you will play a key role in connecting business needs, data, and technology. You will work closely with colleagues across the organization, including our Business Intelligence Controller, to make effective use of enterprise data and take AI solutions from early ideas into secure and maintainable production use.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Understanding business needs and translating them into AI solutions

• Designing, building, testing, and deploying AI agents and applications

• Collaborating with stakeholders, partners, and consultants while retaining technical ownership

• Embedding security, governance, compliance, and responsible AI into solutions from day one

• Contributing to the AI roadmap by prioritizing opportunities based on impact and feasibility

Are you the one to build our AI foundation?

We are looking for someone who combines technical capabilities with curiosity, ownership, and business understanding.

You may have a background in software engineering, data engineering, cloud architecture, machine learning engineering, applied AI, solution architecture, or a related field. Your exact background is less important than your ability to design, build, and deliver AI solutions that work reliably in practice.

You are comfortable moving between architecture and implementation. You can discuss a business challenge with a non-technical colleague, translate it into a technical solution, and then contribute directly to building and operating that solution.

You likely:

• Experience delivering AI, data, or software solutions from concept to production

• Experience with Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Copilot, and Foundry, including security, governance, and compliance

• Solid understanding of data engineering, ETL processes, data lakes, APIs, and systems integration

• Ability to make sound technical decisions balancing security, reliability, performance, maintainability, user experience, and cost

• Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical topics into clear business recommendations

• Experience in business process optimization and identifying opportunities for improvement

• A proactive and curious mindset, combining technical skills with the ability to understand business needs across functions

Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Azure, Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, or similar technologies would be an advantage.  More importantly, you have a demonstrated ability to deliver real-world AI, data, or software solutions, regardless of platform or academic background.

Not checking every box?

You do not need to meet every requirement to do well in this role. AI technologies continue to develop rapidly, and we value people who can learn, adapt, and apply solid technical principles across different platforms.

If the opportunity excites you and you believe you can make a meaningful contribution, we welcome your application.

What you can look forward to

At Uni-Tankers, people make the difference. You will join a collaborative culture built on trust, ownership, and teamwork.

In this role, you will have a unique opportunity to help establish our technical AI foundation and shape how AI is applied across the organization. You will work closely with colleagues across functions and locations, turning business needs, technology, and data into practical solutions that create value for both the business and the people behind it.

You will have room to shape technical decisions, development practices, architecture, and future priorities while remaining close to hands-on delivery.

In return, we offer:

• An international environment with knowledgeable and dedicated colleagues

• A high degree of influence and ownership in a strategically important area

• The opportunity to build and implement solutions rather than only advise on them

• Close collaboration with colleagues working with data, technology, operations, and business development

• Attractive employee benefits, including pension, health insurance, and lunch arrangement

• Social activities and events throughout the year

• Modern office facilities at our headquarters in Middelfart.

Application

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.occupation: Product Manager, Flat Roof Windows
jobs.description:
Flat Roof Windows is one of VELUX's strongest growth opportunities. We are looking for a Product Manager who can help unlock its full potential.

In this role, you will combine strategy, product management, and commercial leadership to identify where future growth will come from and how we turn opportunities into business results.

Your Responsibilities

Based at our headquarter in Hørsholm, you will join the global Flat Roof Windows Category Management team, a highly engaged team of five professionals, - including you.

Reporting to the Head of Flat Roof Windows, Category Management, you will contribute to the product roadmap process by providing insights, analyses, and recommendations that support both future product development and the optimization of existing products, helping to unlock new growth opportunities and improve market performance.

Working across Product Development, Marketing, Sales, Finance, Operations, Strategy and regional organizations, - you will drive business development initiatives that strengthen strategic and commercial growth, competitiveness, and profitability.

Key responsibilities include:

• Working closely with Product Development to define requirements, evaluate opportunities, challenge assumptions, and influence the future direction of our product portfolio throughout the product lifecycle.

• Identify and drive strategic and commercial growth initiatives across the category including driving business development activities, KPI tracking, and performance follow-up in close collaboration with regional markets.

• Leading pricing activities through market analysis and commercial insights to strengthen competitiveness and profitability.

• Building robust business cases and recommendations that support data-driven decision-making and organizational alignment.

• Monitoring market trends, customer behaviour, competitive activity, regulations, and category performance to identify opportunities and risks.

The role includes some travel within Denmark and internationally, to engage with customers, markets, and colleagues across the organization.

Your Profile

There is no single path to success in this role. While your experience is important, your mindset, curiosity, and ability to create impact are equally valued.

You combine strategic thinking with a hands-on approach and understand that great ideas only create value when successfully implemented. You naturally build relationships, challenge constructively, and bring stakeholders together around a common goal.

Most importantly, you are motivated by creating meaningful business results while working collaboratively in a dynamic international environment.

We imagine that you:

• Have at relevant degree combined with at least 5 years of product management experience in a global organization, preferably within a technical or manufacturing industry.

• Possess strong commercial acumen and understand how product, pricing, and portfolio decisions drive business performance.

• Have experience working with structured product development frameworks and stage-gate processes, preferably within technical product environments.

• Demonstrate strong analytical skills and sound judgment to transform market insights, customer understanding, and data into compelling business cases that drive strategic and commercial decisions

• Demonstrate strong team player and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust, influence decisions, and drive collaboration across a complex matrix organization.

• Communicate confidently and effectively in English, adapting your communication to different audiences.

In addition, you are energized by working in a fast-paced environment and contribute positively to team culture, even during periods of high activity.

What We Offer

This is an opportunity to influence decisions that matter.

You will join a team with a central role in shaping the future of one of the VELUX Group's most important growth categories. The position offers significant exposure across the organization and a chance to influence business-critical decisions with direct commercial impact.

This is not a traditional product management role focused solely on maintaining an existing portfolio. It is an opportunity to identify where future growth will come from, define the strategic choices required, and help mobilize the organization to realize that potential.

You will work alongside experienced and passionate colleagues in a collaborative environment characterized by openness, trust, knowledge-sharing, and high ambitions.

As a values-driven company, the VELUX Group is guided by commitment, courage, mutual respect, and teamwork. We offer significant responsibility, strong development opportunities, and the chance to contribute to creating better living environments around the world.

Application and Contact

To learn more about the VELUX Group and life at VELUX, please visit VELUX Careers.

We encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Applications and interviews will be reviewed and conducted on an ongoing basis.

Join us and help shape the future of Flat Roof Windows.

jobs.occupation: Post Market Surveillance Manager
jobs.description:

About the department

You will report to the Head of Scientific Affairs and you will be part of our growing global RA organization based in Copenhagen, which currently includes around 30 people. You will interact with a wide range of stakeholders and especially with Product Creation, Customer Support, Product Management, Global Sales, Resellers, and external consultants worldwide. You will assist with developing the future of disruptive MedTech in collaboration with the entire organization and enable people across the world to enjoy better lives.

Your new job in 3Shape

As our new Post-Market Surveillance Manager (PMS) you will lead and facilitate PMS activities in accordance with relevant global regulations to support our products with regard to safety and performance.

Your key responsibilities

• Lead and maintain the company's PMS program in accordance with EU MDR, FDA, ISO 13485, and other global requirements.

• Develop and maintain PMS Plans, PMS Reports, PSURs, PMCF reports, and trend analyses.

• Monitor and evaluate complaints, adverse events, customer feedback, and other post-market data sources.

• Identify safety and performance trends and support risk management activities.

• Collaborate with Regulatory Affairs, Product Creation, and Product Management to drive continuous product improvement.

• Lead vigilance assessments and regulatory reporting activities for adverse events, serious incidents, and field safety corrective actions (FSCAs), ensuring compliance with global medical device regulations.

• Manage submissions and maintenance of regulatory documentation within EUDAMED.

• Assist with audits and inspections

• Present PMS findings and recommendations to cross-functional teams and senior leadership.

Your profile

We are looking for a person with:

• Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, Biomedical Sciences, Public Health, Healthcare, or related field

• Relevant Quality, Regulatory or Vigilance operational experience from the medical device industry

• Knowledge of EU medical device regulations/directives, including ISO-13485 and ISO-14971

• Excellent planning, cooperation, and communication skills

• Basic AI knowledge preferable within tools used for PMS, Vigilance and trending

• Basic statistical knowledge

As a person, you are a good team player with strong interpersonal skills who thrives working with multiple stakeholders and partners, both internally and externally. Also, you have the ability to successfully handle multiple tasks while managing tight deadlines.

We offer:

• An attractive office environment in downtown Copenhagen, next to Kongens Nytorv

• An inspiring work environment in an informal atmosphere, with social, diverse, and highly skilled colleagues

• A professional challenge in a dynamic, globally-oriented business environment

• Empowerment and influence over your own tasks

We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

Da vores nuværende baneforvalter ønsker at gå ned i tid, søger vi en ny til at afløse ham.

Spar Nord Arena – Aalborg Væddeløbsbane er med 40 årlige løbsdage Danmarks mest aktive væddeløbsbane. ·At passe opvisnings- og træningsbaner.

jobs.occupation: Marketing Automation Specialist | Maternity Cover
jobs.description:
**THE OPPORTUNITY

**At Boozt, we are rethinking how we connect with our customers through data, personalisation, automation and AI. As our CRM setup continues to evolve, we are looking for a Marketing Automation Specialist who wants to help shape the next chapter.

This is an opportunity to take an active role in developing how we work with marketing automation at Boozt. You will join a team with ambitions to make our communication smarter, more relevant and more data-driven, with room to challenge existing approaches and explore how new technology can improve the way we work.

If you enjoy combining technical expertise with curiosity and a drive to make things better, this is your chance to make a real impact on how we do CRM at Boozt.

**What You Will Do

**You will be part of our CRM team, working hands-on with Salesforce Marketing Cloud to build and manage automated communications across email, app push and SMS. You will work closely with customer data to set up segmentation and personalisation, design targeted communications and continuously improve how we reach our customers.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• 
Build and manage automated communications and recurring campaigns in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC).

• 
Set up audience segmentation and personalisation using customer data, including SQL and AMPscript where relevant.

• 
Design and build personalised communications across email, app push and SMS.

• 
Analyse campaign performance, run A/B tests and use insights to improve results.

• 
Work closely with the CRM and market teams to ensure relevant communication across markets.

• 
Explore how AI and automation can improve the way we build, personalise and optimise customer communications.

**YOUR PROFILE

**You have hands-on experience with marketing automation and enjoy combining technical execution with analytical thinking and a curiosity for what is possible. You take ownership of your work, look for ways to improve and are comfortable exploring new approaches.

**We Imagine That You Bring

**

• 
Around 3 years of experience with marketing automation, preferably within CRM.

• 
Experience with a platform such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze, Adobe, Agillic, Voyado, Bloomreach or Klaviyo.

• 
A solid understanding of segmentation, personalisation, automated journeys and campaign testing.

• 
Experience working with campaign KPIs and using data to improve performance.

• 
An interest in AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini and how they can support your daily work.

• 
Strong written communication skills and fluency in English.

Experience with SQL and AMPscript, as well as working across multiple markets, is a plus.

**WHY BOOZT

**At Boozt, you will join a fast-paced and ambitious environment where you have the freedom and responsibility to make a real impact. As part of our CRM team, you will work at the intersection of customer experience, data, technology and commercial growth. This approximately 14-month maternity cover is an opportunity to take ownership, explore new ideas and help shape the customer experience for millions of customers while developing your skills in e-commerce CRM.

**Apply today – we’re excited to learn more about you!

_Only applications submitted in English will be considered.

_Important: Applicants must have the legal right to work in Denmark at the time of employment. Please note that this position does not include visa sponsorship or relocation support.

We review applications on an ongoing basis. You can read more about the process under **Recruitment.

****BOOZT PERKS

**

• 
Great personal and internal career development opportunities

• 
A culture built on our values of trust, freedom, and responsibility

• 
Driven and passionate international colleagues

• 
A generous employee discount

• 
Healthy and delicious breakfast and lunch, top-quality coffee, and fresh fruit available all day

• 
In-house gym, onsite masseuse, and medical doctor

• 
An amazing HQ in central Copenhagen – the iconic, energy-efficient Krystallen building, recognized for its architectural design and sustainability. Enjoy breathtaking city views and much more!

jobs.occupation: Functional Solution Architect / Senior Consultant – D365 Finance & Operations
jobs.description:
Are you a passionate Finance Consultant with experience in Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations? Then we offer you the opportunity for a unique position with exciting projects, great colleagues, excellent facilities, and the chance to develop your skills while contributing to our continued success at Cepheo.

At Cepheo, we take pride in having many talented employees across the Nordics who are dedicated to working with the entire Microsoft Dynamics platform. We’re excited to say that, due to new international projects, we now have room for more talented colleagues to join our team.

The Finance & Operations team covers a wide range of industries, including manufacturing, construction, utilities and energy, wholesale, and retail. For this position, your primary focus will be on our manufacturing clients. Therefore, knowledge of this segment is an advantage - but not a requirement - as your expertise in financial processes within D365FO is what truly matters.

About Cepheo

Cepheo empowers businesses to adapt and succeed in a changing world. With locations across the Nordics and decades of experience in implementing and developing industry-specific solutions based on the Microsoft platform, we help our customers use technology and data to make more informed decisions, optimize daily operations, and bring out the best in their people.

In Denmark, Cepheo has offices across the country, and you can choose the location that suits you best. We have offices in Copenhagen, Aarhus, Aalborg, Thisted, and Kolding, with a total of 110 employees fully focused on Microsoft Dynamics solutions. The largest business area in Denmark - and across the entire group - is Finance & Operations. In addition to close collaboration with our sister companies in Norway and Sweden, we also work closely with Cepheo Poland, our nearshore center with around 100 employees.

After two years of establishing Cepheo as a strong new brand in the Dynamics market, we are now ready to accelerate our growth. The foundation is in place with new and ongoing large international projects.

As a consultant at Cepheo, you are allocated 10% of your time for skills development - and we can ensure you that we walk the talk. We can document that we meet this goal, and we view education as an investment that makes us stronger - we do not see it as a cost.

About the position

As a Functional Solution Architect / Senior Consultant, you will be part of a strong team focused on ERP processes, working across the entire Dynamics platform - especially F&O, but also the Power Platform. We value learning from each other and taking shared responsibility. We believe this broad collaboration is essential for continuous professional development, which is why Cepheo dedicates time and resources to training and knowledge sharing.

You’ll join a team of skilled and highly experienced D365FO consultants, ensuring high-level sparring. You’ll also experience a fast pace environment, as you’ll be involved in new projects from the early stages, helping to set the scene. You’ll work closely with Cepheo’s other F&O teams (Project Management, Service Delivery Managers, Developers - both Danish and Polish colleagues - and infrastructure technicians).

As an architect within the finance area, you’ll carry significant responsibility in the project. You’ll challenge the customer on process optimization within your area of expertise and coordinate with colleagues handling other workstreams to ensure cohesion. We know that all issues in the various business areas eventually impact finance, so you’ll play a key role in mitigating potential challenges. Familiarity (not deep expertise) with other process areas such as procurement, sales, inventory, and production is essential for success in the role.

You’ll be introduced to Cepheo’s implementation model, which is based on a well-documented process framework. You’ll find that Cepheo is at the forefront of process-oriented approaches, and your tasks will reflect that.

You’ll also have the opportunity to join our Nordic Capability Group for Finance & Operations, giving you a network with colleagues in Scandinavia and Poland, where you can share knowledge and learn from others that works in the same field as you.

Who are you?

We expect that you have several years of experience as a consultant within D365FO solutions, preferably with experience in financial solutions for manufacturing clients.

Additionally, we expect you to have experience with relevant third-party financial solutions such as AMC Banking, SK Global, and Exflow. Experience with international projects is also an advantage. At Cepheo, you’ll take ownership of how projects are delivered. You’ll work closely with customers and typically be involved from the analysis phase through implementation and ongoing support and development.

We value quality and expect you to be a strong communicator in both Danish and English. It’s also a plus if you are naturally proactive, curious, structured, and possess strong business acumen.

We’re looking for a colleague with several of the following competencies:

• Experienced D365FO consultant within the finance domain

• Industry knowledge in the manufacturing domain

• Solid experience within Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations

• Understanding of functionality related to sales, purchasing, logistics, etc., enabling you to advise on the connection between the value chain and the finance department, including reconciliation with inventory, costing, etc.

• Familiarity with finance-related add-on solutions

• Strong experience in designing standard solutions

• A customer oriented mindset and a naturally service-minded approach

• Comfortable working independently as well as part of a strong team

• A strong drive and eagerness to learn and be challenged

• Strong analytical and communication skills

Interested?

If you have any questions about the position or would like to know more, feel free to contact us. You can reach out to our Director of F&O, Uffe Pallesen, through uffe.pallesen@cepheo.com or phone 52 18 53 35. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis and are looking to hire a permanent employee. We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.occupation: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Join us to Make an Impact

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**About The Role

**We are looking for a Project Manager to join our New Product Introduction (NPI) team.

As Project Manager in NPI you will work closely together with optical, electrical, mechanical and software engineers on maturing design and developing assembly and test processes. When the project has proven the product can be manufactured with satisfactory yield, it will be transferred to Operations, freeing up space and resources for the new next project.

**What You Will Do

**

• Lead maturation and transfer projects of laser products.

• Be responsible for planning resource alignment, risk and change management, project reporting, and follow-up the gate process to ensure projects are delivered within scope, on time, and within budget.

**What You Bring

**To succeed in this role, you should have a technical background in one or more of the following areas: optics/photonics, electronics, or production engineering.

**Essential

**

• Demonstrated experience delivering complex technical projects, ideally related to product development, product maturation, or technology transfer.

• Ability to effectively lead technical specialists and facilitate project meetings, design reviews, and key decision-making processes.

• Experience working in a manufacturing environment.

• Communicate fluently in English and thrive in cross-functional, international teams.

**What We Offer

**We want you to feel supported, both at work and outside it. Our benefits include:

• A 12% employer-paid pension contribution and health insurance.

• An annual bonus programme.

• 25 days of paid vacation, plus five additional days once you have been with us for nine months.

• Access to thousands of courses through LinkedIn Learning.

• Wellbeing initiatives and an annual flu vaccination.

• Freshly prepared meals from our subsidised on-site canteen.

• Free parking at our Birkerød site.

• Social activities through our Employee Association.

_Benefits are subject to eligibility and the relevant plan or policy terms.

_**Practical Information

**

• Working arrangement: On site

• Working language: English

• Employment: Full time

**Keep your personal data safe

**Hamamatsu ("The Company") take responsibly for the protection of your personal data. Accordingly, upon receiving your job application and additional material you choose to submit, the Company keeps a safe and secure environment and ensures confidentiality.

You also have a role to play in keeping your personal data safe. We request you only submit personal data about yourself in your job application, CV / Résumé or other relevant material you choose to provide to us that is relevant for the specific job opening you are applying for.

Please consider whether there is personal information you are about to submit, such as health information, information on family relations, information on trade union membership, etc. that is not necessary for our recruitment process or the job opening you are applying for. Please also be aware that certificates or other documents are not necessary for the vacancy. We urgently request you to redact/cross out such information before you submit your job application.

Thank you.
